description: Pakistan State Oil Company Limited is Pakistan's largest energy marketing company, operating a country-wide network of 3,528 retail outlets, nine installations, 19 depots, refuelling facilities at 14 airports and operations at two seaports, with storage capacity of 1.14 million tons. It supplies motor gasoline, high-speed diesel, jet fuel, furnace oil, LPG and LNG, and manufactures and markets lubricants under brands including Carient, Blaze and DEO. The PSO Group comprises Pakistan State Oil as the holding company and Pakistan Refinery Limited as its subsidiary.
headOffice: PSO House, Khayaban-e-Iqbal, Clifton, Karachi, Pakistan
